correctness.rationale: The statement is confined to the canonical abstract 72-vertex graph and every conjugacy class of its 51,840-element Weyl action. The exact divisor-class enumeration independently verifies all 45 anticanonical triples and strong regularity (27,10,1,5), and Bareiss proves the reduced-Laplacian determinant 3^62 5^6. The lattice coinvariant presentation [L_r | G_r-I] follows from the degree-zero basis; the graph monodromy pairing gives fixed/coinvariant Pontryagin duality. Exact prime-local row/column operations modulo 81 and 25 on both r=0 and r=71 yield identical groups for 25 conjugacy classes. Since the finite full group has order 3^62 5^6 and no Smith valuation reaches the modular cutoff, these are complete integral invariant factors, not numerical guesses. The standalone packaged checker replays all operations.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete finite classification of an arithmetic graph-Jacobian invariant for the canonical line–tritangent configuration of cubic surfaces, across all 25 Weyl Galois types. It yields 23 different fixed-group isomorphism types and, decisively, distinguishes two arithmetically distinct order-three Weyl classes with identical cycle partition on all 27 lines by absent versus rank-two 5-primary torsion; thus the precise invariant adds information not encoded by the familiar geometric graph, ordinary Jacobian, Picard cohomology or line splitting counts. It plausibly informs integral Galois-module/degeneration comparisons without asserting a Néron-model theorem.
